summary: S&P Global (NYSE:SPGI) added Visible Alpha data to its AI Data Portal, giving clients AI-ready sell-side consensus figures. headline: Should You Trim Or Add To Your Joby Aviation Position Now?
summary: Joby Aviation (JOBY) stock has lost around 70% over the past year. The S&P 500 returned 17% during that same period. The worry for shareholders is whether paying passengers will board the company's air taxis before its funding dries up. Joby is not short of money yet, ending June 2026 with about $2.3 billion in cash and short-term investments. So what does Joby sell today, and what is it spending the cash on.

headline: Can Trade Desk Stock Bounce Off Its Old Support Again?
summary: Investors holding Trade Desk (TTD) have seen the stock lose 74.1% of its value over the past year, compared with a 17.9% return for the S&P 500. The immediate question is how much further shares might drop. One certainty is the current level: at $13.13 on October 15, the stock sits above the prices where it turned and rallied three times in 2018. How did the stock fare at this price then, and how has it fared in 2026.

headline: Why Did Accenture Stock Jump?
summary: Between July 17 and October 15, 2026, Accenture (ACN) stock rose 57.9%, while the S&P 500 gained 4.1%. The single biggest day in that run occurred on October 1. The company reported its fiscal fourth quarter results, provided a forecast for fiscal 2027, and saw its shares rise 15.8%. So did Accenture's business change as much as its share price did.

headline: Should You Sell Your NuScale Power Stock Now?
summary: Investors holding NuScale Power (SMR) stock have faced a punishing year. While the broader S&P 500 returned 17.9%, the shares lost 86.6%. That decline is firmly embedded in the current valuation, regardless of whether you choose to sell or hold. Anyone maintaining a position now owns an enterprise with minimal revenue, waiting on a pending reactor contract in Romania. So what are you actually holding at today's price.

headline: What Changed For Cipher Digital Stock, And What Did Not?
summary: Shares of Cipher Digital (CIFR) fell 26.4% in the five trading days from October 8 to October 15, 2026. The S&P 500 slipped 0.25% over the same period. The stock saw its worst single-day performance on October 13, when executives announced a plan to sell $850 million of convertible notes. Cipher already carried a large debt, so how much does the new borrowing add to it.

headline: When Amgen's Forecast And Chart Say The Same Thing, Pay Attention
summary: Amgen (AMGN) raised its revenue forecast for fiscal 2026 on August 4. Since the market close before that release, the stock has gained 15.2%, outpacing the 1.9% return of the S&P 500. A higher forecast or a climbing share price means little in isolation. When the corporate numbers and the technical chart align, however, the combination warrants closer scrutiny. So how far did management raise its forecast, and why.

headline: What Are Starbucks Stock Bulls Not Worried About?
summary: Investors are pricing Starbucks (SBUX) stock at 55.7 times its earnings over the last twelve months, well above the 22.7 multiple for the S&P 500. That premium suggests a bet that U.S. customer visits will keep rising and profit will continue its recovery. The company delivered a fourth straight quarter of comparable sales growth in fiscal Q3 2026. Yet executives used the accompanying earnings call to acknowledge pressure on U.S. consumer sentiment. So what is that pressure.

headline: Is Amgen Stock Increasing Your Market Risk?
summary: Investors holding shares of Amgen (AMGN), the $234 billion maker of drugs such as Repatha and Prolia, likely pair that position with broad exposure to the S&P 500. As the broader market rises and falls each day, the pharmaceutical stock's individual performance blends with the rest of that capital. So when the market drops, does Amgen make your losses bigger.
